def build(p):
    R = p.rim_radius
    box = (cq.Workplane("XY").circle(R).extrude(p.depth)
           .cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(p.disk_radius)
                .translate((0, 0, p.wall)).extrude(p.depth - p.wall)))

        box = box.union(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(p.boss_r).center(sx, 0).extrude(p.depth))
        box = box.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").center(sx, 0).circle(p.insert_hole_d / 2)
                      .translate((0, 0, p.depth - p.insert_depth)).extrude(p.insert_depth))

    # perfboard posts + pilot holes
    cx = p.perf_w / 2 - p.perf_hole_center_inset
    cy = p.perf_l / 2 - p.perf_hole_center_inset
    for (px, py) in ((cx, cy), (-cx, cy), (cx, -cy), (-cx, -cy)):
        box = box.union(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(p.post_r).center(px, py).extrude(p.post_top))
        box = box.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").center(px, py).circle(p.m2_pilot_d / 2)
                      .translate((0, 0, p.post_top - p.pilot_depth)).extrude(p.pilot_depth))

    # USB opening through rim (+x side)
    box = box.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").box(p.wall + 8, p.usb_slot_w, p.usb_slot_h)
                  .translate((p.rim_radius - p.wall / 2, p.usb_y, p.usb_z)))

    # top wire gap in rim
    box = box.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").box(p.wire_slot_w, p.wall + 8, p.depth)
                  .translate((0, p.rim_radius - p.wall / 2, p.depth / 2)))

    # wall-hang keyholes

                    .center(hx, p.hang_y - p.hang_slot_l / 2)))
        box = box.cut(k.extrude(p.wall))

    return box
